items.question: Who can access the platform?
items.answer: Access is managed through a membership and permission system, customized by user type or target group — doctors, specialists, and healthcare practitioners.

items.question: Is the content SCORM-compliant?
items.answer: The platform supports structured educational content designed to meet SCORM-compliant learning requirements.

items.question: How are quizzes and results handled?
items.answer: Quizzes are integrated into the learning journey, with results recorded to help users track their progress.

items.question: Can I access the platform from mobile?
items.answer: The platform is designed to provide a responsive learning experience across mobile and desktop devices.
